_contract: A PROPOSAL for the Phase-C2 behavioural selection. It AUTHORIZES NOTHING and FUNDS NOTHING: there is no grant, no readiness record, no authorization, no bundle and no provider resource. It exists so a review can see the exact inputs, the exact protocol, the derived storage and the derived money before any of those are created.

protocol_binding._read_not_restated: the schedule, seeds, batteries, anchor, ranking rule and tie-break are READ from the frozen protocol. A second copy is how two documents come to disagree about an experiment that has not run.

screening.ranking_rule: maximize the paired single-seed delta correct_overall(candidate - B) on the screening battery. B is the anchor, never an advancing candidate. usable_rollout is NOT positive ranking credit.
screening.tie_break: the already-frozen full-search ordering, then the deterministic state id. Both are fixed before any behavioural datum exists.
screening.decides: which 1 candidate(s) advance. Ranking only — no veto is evaluated here and no promotion can be claimed from it.
screening._no_verdict_here: screening may not produce GO/NO_GO/INCONCLUSIVE and may not promote

confirmation.decides: the C2 incumbent, under the frozen Phase-C decision rule. This is the only evidence that may name one.

protocol_binding.no_canonical_control: the project's original initialization is NOT carried forward as a C2 arm. It answers no additional C2 question: a candidate that beats the old control but loses to B must not promote, and one that bea

candidate_inputs._joined_not_transcribed: each entry is attempt 3's frozen selection JOINED to the destination-verified durable product the replay reconstructed. The join IS the check: a product whose identity differs from what the selection commits is refused, so this session cannot be pointed at a checkpoint nobody reconstructed.

anchor_b.role: frozen_c1_treatment_b -- the behavioural incumbent and the only anchor

components_gib._staged_initializations_is: 6 screening arms -- the five reconstructed candidates and the incumbent B, each staged before any probe runs
components_gib._working_set_is: 596,049,920 parameters as bf16 weights plus an fp32 gradient and AdamW's two fp32 moments. Probes run sequentially, so exactly one of these is resident at a time

storage._why_not_400: the full search's 400 GB was derived for a beam that generates a whole level before pruning and holds sixty compressed states at the level boundary. This session holds one training working set at a time and retains twelve small checkpoints; carrying 400 GB here would bill for storage nothing uses.
storage._why_it_rounds_up: a volume that fills mid-probe loses the probe. The margin is 25% over a component sum that is itself derived from measured artifact sizes.

money._gpu_rate_is_live: re-quoted from gpuTypes.securePrice; the authorization must re-quote again at issue
money.probe_minutes_basis: logs/stages/stage-1/phase_c1/runs/attempt18/evidence/c1_evidence.json stages F/G/H, with per-probe PROBE_TRAINED/PROBE_SCORED markers from logs/stages/stage-1/phase_c1/runs/attempt18/evidence/driver_run.log
money._ceiling_includes: both named reserves, a 10% contingency and a 30-minute artifact recovery reserve
money._two_numbers: the GPU rate is re-quotable from the provider and the storage price is not, so they are derived apart and summed. A live GPU quote is not evidence that separately priced storage is free.

_historical_planning_reference._what_changed: the GPU minutes are unchanged -- they come from the same six measured probes. The all-in ceiling is LOWER because the storage provision is derived from this session's own topology (90 GB) instead of carrying the full search's 400 GB, which was sized for a beam holding sixty compressed states at a level boundary.

explicitly_not_proposed: any re-ranking of the 14 complete leaves
any B remeasurement outside the 12-probe protocol
the original canonical control as a C2 arm

implementation_state.protocol_binding: BUILT and verified against the frozen protocol's own hash
implementation_state.candidate_manifest: BUILT; all five join and verify
implementation_state.storage_derivation: BUILT; 90 GB derived from measured artifact sizes
implementation_state.money_derivation: BUILT; live quote, GPU and storage derived apart
implementation_state.launcher_and_driver: NOT BUILT. The session is structurally C1's probe machinery run twice: stage the six arms from durable products rather than building them (replacing C1 stages B/C/DE/F), train and score six screening probes (C1 stages G/H), rank and advance exactly one, then train and score six confirmation probes on three paired seeds and decide under C1's frozen rule. Stated as outstanding rather than sketched: a driver written without being rehearsed at toy scale is how four paid pods in this programme died in lines nothing had executed.
